ownerIntake.ownerGoal: Decide whether to raise membership price 15%
ownerConstraints: Rent renewal raises fixed costs ~$3,000/mo next quarter
ownerIntake.immediateConcern: Flat growth + rising costs; considering a 15% price increase

businessProblem: A single-location gym has 1,000 members at $40/mo (contribution ~$36/member), fixed costs $28,000/mo, net ~$8,000/mo, flat member growth for 6 months, and a rent renewal raising fixed costs ~$3,000/mo. The owner is considering a 15% price increase but worries about losing members. Should the owner raise prices, and what would you need to know to decide with confidence?

evidence.finding: 1,000 members at $40/mo; contribution ~$36/member; fixed costs $28,000/mo; net ~$8,000/mo; rent renewal adds ~$3,000/mo
Net member growth approximately flat for 6 months
Near capacity at peak hours; off-peak capacity underused
